identificationModule.briefTitle: DV Combined With PD-1 and Platinum-based First-line Treatment in Patients With HER2 IHC2+/3+ ESCC
identificationModule.officialTitle: DV Combined With PD-1 and Platinum-based First-line Treatment in Patients With Locally Advanced or Metastatic HER2 IHC2+/3+ Esophageal Squamous Cell Carcinoma

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a single-arm, exploratory clinical study.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: This is a single-arm, exploratory clinical study. Aim to explore the safety and efficacy of Vedicetuzumab combined with an immune checkpoint inhibitor (carrellizumab) and platinum-based first-line treatment for locally advanced/metastatic HER2 overexpression (IHC 2+/3+) esophageal squamous cell carcinoma.

armGroups.label: RC48+PD-1+platinum-based

interventions.name: RC48+PD-1+platinum-based
interventions.description:
Phase I: Three subjects with HER2 overexpression (IHC 2+/3+) were initially enrolled. If dose-limiting toxicity (DLT) was observed in two of the three subjects, the study was continued from dose 1 to dose 2. If ≤1 DLT is observed in 3 subjects, continue to enroll 3 patients, and if ≤2 DLT is observed in 6 subjects, proceed to the second phase. If \> 2 cases of DLT are observed in 6 subjects, adjust to dose 2 for phase 2.

Dose 1: RC48 2.5mg/kg, d1, once every 3 weeks; Camrelizumab 200mg, d1 once every 3 weeks; Platinum: Cisplatin 75mg/m2(or nedaplatin 75mg/m2), d1, once every 3 weeks

Dose 2: RC48 2.0mg/kg, d1, once every 3 weeks; Camrelizumab 200mg, d1 once every 3 weeks; Platinum: Cisplatin 75mg/m2(or nedaplatin 75mg/m2), d1, once every 3 weeks

The second stage: sample size expansion stage. RP2D obtained at stage 1 continues to be enrolled in up to 20 patients until disease progression or intolerable toxicity occurs.

primaryOutcomes.description: Defined as maximum tolerated dose or maximum administration dose.
The time between the start of treatment and the onset of disease progression or death

secondaryOutcomes.description: The percentage of patients whose tumors have shrunk to a certain amount and remain there for a certain amount of time, including complete response (CR) and partial response (PR) cases
